personal.name: Parag Karkhanis
personal.title: Senior Director / VP Sales — Aerospace & Defence | Engineering Services | OEM & Tier-1 New Business

summary: Aerospace sales leader with 18+ years selling engineering and technical services to OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers across the US, Europe, and the Middle East. Aerospace and defence has been the through-line of my career — from Boeing, Airbus, and Collins to the defence programs I helped capture — and I have spent it doing exactly what this role calls for: opening new accounts, translating engineering design, analysis, digital, and testing capabilities into business value, and leading solution-based deals from a first CxO conversation through proposal, pricing, negotiation, and close. I work hands-on with engineering and delivery teams to keep solutions technically sound, and I know the aerospace and MRO ecosystem from both the engineering-services and manufacturing sides. I consistently deliver above target and build relationships that last well beyond a single deal.

technical: Engineering services sales (design, analysis, testing, PLM)
soft: CxO relationship management (VP Engineering, CIO, CTO)
